h:
1.0版本

此 ComfyUI 工作流程的第一个版本适用于带有 TCD 的 SDXL Pony。最初的工作流程是由 Eface 制作的，我只是对其进行了清理并添加了一些 QoL 更改以使其更易于访问。经他同意，我在此发布此内容！此工作流程有很多旋钮需要扭转和转动，但在默认设置下应该可以完美地满足您的大多数需求。可以使用 ComfyUI Manager 找到自定义节点。如果遇到问题，请阅读每个节点的说明，了解如何使用它！

o.en:
Version 1.0

The first release of this ComfyUI workflow for SDXL Pony with TCD. The original Workflow was made by Eface, I just cleaned it up and added some QoL changes to make it more accessible. I am publishing this here with his agreement! This workflow has a lot of knobs to twist and turn, but should work perfectly fine with the default settings for most to all your needs. Custom nodes can be found with ComfyUI Manager. Read the description of each node on how to use it if you run into issues!
